create_src_lengths_mask: create a boolean mask tensor to prevent attention beyond the end of source sequences
masked_softmax: apply source length masking then softmax to attention scores with optional masking
build_DotAttention: build a dot product attention module with optional input projection and source length masking
build_MultiheadAttention: build a multihead attention module with query key value projections and incremental state support
build_DecoupledMultiheadAttention: build a decoupled multihead attention module that wraps MultiheadAttention with source length masking
